nodes.name: LocalCacheProgramShowTime.java
nodes.summary: Caffeine-based local cache for ProgramShowTime entities with per-entry expiry computed from the show time, used as a near-cache layer in the program service.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Caffeine's Expiry interface to compute TTL dynamically from each entry's show time.

nodes.name: LocalCacheProgramShowTime
nodes.summary: Spring component wrapping a Caffeine cache of ProgramShowTime entries with lazy loading and invalidation support.

nodes.name: localLockCacheInit
nodes.summary: Builds the Caffeine cache with a maximum size and a custom Expiry that expires entries at their show time.

nodes.name: ProgramDetailCheckHandler.java
nodes.summary: Order-check handler that validates seat selection and per-order purchase limits against program detail before order creation.

nodes.name: ProgramDetailCheckHandler
nodes.summary: Concrete program check handler extending AbstractProgramCheckHandler, verifying seat-choosing permission and purchase count limits.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Fetches program detail via programService.detailV2 and throws DaMaiFrameException when seat selection or ticket count violates program rules.

nodes.name: ProgramTimeType.java
nodes.summary: Constant definitions for program time filter types (all, today, tomorrow, week, month, calendar) used in program queries.

nodes.name: ProgramTimeType
nodes.summary: Holder of integer constants representing supported program show-time filter ranges.

nodes.name: DelayOperateProgramDataConsumer.java
nodes.summary: Delay-queue consumer that receives program data operation messages and delegates them to ProgramService.operateProgramData.

nodes.name: DelayOperateProgramDataConsumer
nodes.summary: ConsumerTask implementation consuming delayed program-data operation messages from the Redisson delay queue.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Parses the JSON message content into ProgramOperateDataDto and invokes ProgramService.operateProgramData.

nodes.name: DelayOrderCancelSend.java
nodes.summary: Producer component that sends order-cancellation messages into the Redisson delay queue for deferred processing.

nodes.name: DelayOrderCancelSend
nodes.summary: Spring component wrapping DelayQueueContext to publish delayed order-cancel messages under a prefixed topic.

nodes.name: sendMessage
nodes.summary: Sends a message to the delay queue with error logging, using the environment-prefixed topic name.

nodes.name: ProgramEs.java
nodes.summary: Elasticsearch query layer for programs: home lists, recommendations, paged selection, full-text search with highlighting, and document deletion.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes the project's EsDataQueryDto abstraction with native Elasticsearch QueryBuilders/SearchSourceBuilder APIs.

nodes.name: ProgramEs
nodes.summary: Component encapsulating all Elasticsearch read/write operations for program documents via BusinessEsHandle.

nodes.name: selectHomeList
nodes.summary: Queries prime programs per parent category (optionally filtered by area) and groups results into ProgramHomeVo list for the home page.

nodes.name: recommendList
nodes.summary: Builds a bool query with area/category filters, excludes the current program, and applies a random script sort to recommend related programs.

nodes.name: selectPage
nodes.summary: Runs a paged Elasticsearch query over programs with area, prime, category and date-range filters plus configurable sorting.

nodes.name: getProgramPageOrder
nodes.summary: Maps the request's sort type to a ProgramPageOrder (sort field and order) for the paged query.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Performs full-text program search over title and actor with highlighting, filters, sorting and pagination.

nodes.name: getHighlightBuilder
nodes.summary: Constructs an Elasticsearch HighlightBuilder with pre/post tags for the given field names.

nodes.name: deleteByProgramId
nodes.summary: Finds ES documents by program id and deletes each by its document id.

nodes.name: ProgramBloomFilterInit.java
nodes.summary: Startup initializer that loads all program ids into the Bloom filter to guard program-detail cache penetration.

nodes.name: ProgramBloomFilterInit
nodes.summary: Post-construct handler seeding the Bloom filter with every existing program id at application startup.

nodes.name: executeInit
nodes.summary: Retrieves all program ids from ProgramService and adds each to the Bloom filter.

nodes.name: ProgramCategoryInitData.java
nodes.summary: Startup initializer that asynchronously warms program-category Redis data via the business thread pool.

nodes.name: ProgramCategoryInitData
nodes.summary: Post-construct handler triggering programCategoryRedisDataInit on the business thread pool at startup.

nodes.name: ProgramDocumentParamName.java
nodes.summary: Constants defining the Elasticsearch index name and all document field names for program documents.

nodes.name: ProgramDocumentParamName
nodes.summary: Holder of ES index/type names and 20+ document field-name constants used by program ES queries and indexing.

nodes.name: ProgramElasticsearchInitData.java
nodes.summary: Startup initializer that creates the program Elasticsearch index with mapping and bulk-indexes all program documents.

nodes.name: ProgramElasticsearchInitData
nodes.summary: Post-construct handler orchestrating ES index creation and full program document indexing on the business thread pool.

nodes.name: executeInit
nodes.summary: Submits the Elasticsearch data initialization to the business thread pool with error logging.

nodes.name: initElasticsearchData
nodes.summary: Recreates the index, loads every program detail from the database, builds document maps including min/max price, and adds them to Elasticsearch.

nodes.name: indexAdd
nodes.summary: Checks, deletes and recreates the program index with the document mapping.

nodes.name: getEsMapping
nodes.summary: Builds the list of EsDocumentMappingDto entries defining field types for the program document mapping.

nodes.name: ProgramShowTimeRenewal.java
nodes.summary: Startup renewal task that refreshes program show times, drops the ES index when programs changed, and clears stale Redis/local caches.

nodes.name: ProgramShowTimeRenewal
nodes.summary: Post-construct handler coordinating show-time renewal, ES index invalidation and cache cleanup at startup.

nodes.name: executeInit
nodes.summary: Renews show times, deletes the stale ES index if any program was renewed, and evicts Redis and local program caches.

nodes.name: ProgramDataTask.java
nodes.summary: Scheduled task that asynchronously resets program execution state, renews show times and re-initializes Elasticsearch data.

nodes.name: ProgramDataTask
nodes.summary: Component exposing executeTask to run program data reset, show-time renewal and ES reindexing on the business thread pool.

nodes.name: executeTask
nodes.summary: Runs program reset for every program id, then triggers show-time renewal and ES data re-initialization asynchronously.
